entries: The presence was {the_someone:human}, who only wanted {the_thing:portable} returned.
{the_someone:human,!plural} did not know years had passed; {the_thing} told {first}.
{the_message:physical} had been written by {CLOSE:human} long before {the_disaster}.
It was {first} who lingered at {landmark:built}, and {the_someone:human} had been waiting to say so.
{the_disaster} had never ended: {the_someone:human} lived it again {MANNER}.
The one who stayed was not {the_someone:human} but {CLOSE:human}, held there by {MOTIVE}.
{first} had carried {the_thing:!living} {HIDING} all along, and its weight kept {the_someone:human} near.
The cold at {landmark:built} was only {CLOSE:human}, sitting with {first}.
The {rival} had listened at {landmark:built} for years, out of {MOTIVE}.
{THING:portable} lay {HIDING}: what {the_someone:human} left, and what {first} was meant to find.
Letting go was all {the_someone:human} asked, and {first} had refused {MANNER}.
{the_someone:human} stayed for {MOTIVE}, and left the moment {first} spoke of {VALUE}.
